note: This file is a pure MMDetection configuration file containing only dictionary and list assignments. It has no functions, classes, or callable code. It defines hyperparameters and architecture for a CenterNet object detection model with a ResNet-50-Caffe backbone, FPN neck, and CenterNetUpdateHead on the COCO dataset.
summarize_config: summarize the CenterNet config file that defines model architecture, training pipeline, and optimizer settings for COCO detection
review_model_architecture: review the CenterNet model dict with ResNet50 caffe backbone, FPN neck, and CenterNetUpdateHead configuration
review_train_pipeline: review the multi-scale training pipeline with RandomChoiceResize across six height scales
review_param_scheduler: review the learning rate schedule with LinearLR warmup and MultiStepLR decay at epochs 8 and 11
review_test_cfg: review the test configuration with nms_pre 1000, score threshold 0.05, and max 100 detections per image
